title: Croatian Vegetable Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegetarian bowl filled with roasted vegetables and a hint of Croatian spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the Croatian vegetable mix, chopped onion, and olive oil.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While the vegetables are roasting, cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
If using, poach the egg in a separate pot of boiling water for 3-4 minutes, or until cooked to desired doneness.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked quinoa between two bowls.
Add the roasted vegetables on top of the quinoa, followed by the poached egg (if using).
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and garnish with chopped parsley (if desired).
